culprit_citations.quoted_text: Maple Raptor Acquisition Inc. (dba Rentsync) | Secured Loan | April 28, 2025 | April 28, 2030 | Variable interest rate CORRA 3 Month Term + 9.4 %; EOT 0.0 % | $ | 19,707 | $ | 19,353 | $ | 19,724 | (8)(10)(20)

findings.detail: F27 compares a source-supported income yield with a holdings WAC that cannot represent floating coupons disclosed as reference rate plus spread when no single all-in numeric rate is available.

rationale: The filing reports three-month total interest and dividend income of 83.319 million, agreeing with the extracted fund-financial numerator. The schedule also shows material floating-rate debt as CORRA 3 Month Term plus 9.4%, not as a single numeric coupon. A holdings WAC built from available numeric interest_rate values is therefore incomplete and is not an independent like-for-like ceiling for the filing income yield. The F27 breach is a bad-anchor/rule-scope false alarm, not evidence that the reported fund-financial value is wrong.
